item: A wrong passphrase on the wrapped ML-DSA custody key raises instead of signing with a garbage key pair (audit 0.5.0 A-018)
status: shipped, test-verified (fake ML-DSA module; the real library runs in CI's PQC job)
summary: A failed unwrap of the ML-DSA key with a passphrase held was read as a legacy plaintext key, and the still-wrapped blob was split into a public/secret key pair and used. The wrap format has no magic prefix, so a GCM tag failure cannot tell plaintext from a wrong passphrase or an altered file; the legacy case is now told by LENGTH (exactly public key + secret key, read from a throwaway pair, no library size constant trusted) and anything else raises SigningError with fixed words. Four tests, two red without the change. The Ed25519 path already re-raised a wrong passphrase. Separate from the E3 proposal (the evidence key).
